detail: Cera Sanitaryware Limited, a publicly listed manufacturer of sanitaryware, has made a filing with the NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation mandates disclosure when a person or group acquires or agrees to acquire 25% or more of voting capital, or when acquisition triggers other thresholds. The substantive terms of the transaction—acquirer identity, offer price, stake percentage, conditions, and timeline—require access to the full disclosure document.
